title: tert-Butyl peroxypivalate synthesis
protocol: Aqueous tert-butyl hydroperoxide was converted to potassium tert-butylperoxide with KOH (1.12 equiv), then reacted with pivaloyl chloride in the presence of sodium dodecyl sulfate. The biphasic exothermic reaction was run in a three-necked flask at 23 C for 31 min and afforded tert-butyl peroxypivalate in 53% yield.
objective: Translate the batch protocol into a feasible, safe, and testable continuous-flow design.
